idea-plugin.name: Hydra Defaults Navigation
idea-plugin.description: Cmd/Ctrl+click on a Hydra defaults: entry such as - model: base opens <config root>/model/base.yaml. Handles override, optional, absolute /group keys, group@package and bare - other_config entries. Renaming the target file updates the entry. Cmd/Ctrl+click on a _target_: pkg.module.Class segment opens that package, module or class. Cmd/Ctrl+click on ${data.tile_size} opens the tile_size key of each data option. Cmd/Ctrl+click on a key beside _target_ opens that __init__ parameter. Completes defaults options and group keys, _target_ paths (including methods), __init__ argument names and values (Literal, bool, defaults), and ${...} keys.
